verdict.rationale: Helicone logs every LLM request, so data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for this product. However, the evidence pack documents no retention period settings, deletion API, or log-purge feature. Self-hosting options (Docker Compose, own instance) are an adjacent deployment choice, not a documented retention or deletion control, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
